Rosko Specman returns to Fiji for 2027 Coral Coast Fiji 7s
item.description: South African Rugby 7s star Rosko “Specmagic” Specman is returning to Fiji for the 2027 McDonald’s Coral Coast Fiji 7s, where he will represent the McDonald’s Mike Friday Select 7s. The tournament will mark Specman’s third visit to Fiji, as he reunites with former Blitzboks teammates Branco du Preez and Justin Geduld.
item.content:encoded:
South African Rugby 7s star Rosko “Specmagic” Specman is returning to Fiji for the 2027 McDonald’s Coral Coast Fiji 7s, where he will represent the McDonald’s Mike Friday Select 7s.

The tournament will mark Specman’s third visit to Fiji, as he reunites with former Blitzboks teammates Branco du Preez and Justin Geduld.

Specman, known for his footwork, sidesteps and ability to evade defenders, was inducted into the Rugbytown Walk of Fame in 2026 in recognition of his contribution to international Rugby 7s.

He will join an international line-up assembled by coach Mike Friday, which already includes French Rugby 7s star Terry Bouhraoua and Australian player Pama Fou.

Fiji’s Olympic gold medallist Semi Kunatani and 2026 Campese-Serevi Medal winner Wame Ratuva are also part of the squad, with further player announcements expected.

The Mike Friday Select 7s will be aiming to claim their first Coral Coast title after finishing runners-up in 2025 and reaching the semi-finals in 2026.

item.title: France edge South Africa 21-19 in Nations Championship thriller
item.description: France have secured a dramatic 21-19 victory over world champions South Africa in a thrilling Nations Championship clash at the Stade de France in Paris. Inspired by the playmaking partnership of Antoine Dupont and Maxime Lucu, the Les Bleus produced an impressive attacking display to take a 21-7 lead into half-time.
item.content:encoded:
France have secured a dramatic 21-19 victory over world champions South Africa in a thrilling Nations Championship clash at the Stade de France in Paris.

Inspired by the playmaking partnership of Antoine Dupont and Maxime Lucu, the Les Bleus produced an impressive attacking display to take a 21-7 lead into half-time.

However, France had to withstand a strong second-half comeback from the Springboks, despite having three players sent to the sin bin and conceding nine scrum penalties during the match.

South Africa also faced a setback when Jasper Wiese was shown a red card for a dangerous clearout.

The visitors continued to fight back and scored a late maul try through Malcolm Marx, giving them an opportunity to draw level.

However, Manie Libbok missed the conversion, leaving South Africa two points short of France's total .

A crucial late tackle from Louis Bielle-Biarrey then allowed Dupont to regain possession and help the hosts secure the victory.

The result gives France a hard-fought win over the reigning world champions after a tense finish in Paris.

item.title: Tadhg Beirne to captain Ireland for the first time against Flying Fijians
item.description: Navitalai Naivalurua · 13/11/2026 Munster captain Tadhg Beirne has been named captain of the Ireland side for their Nations Championship clash against the FIJI Water Flying Fijians this Sunday.
item.content:encoded:
Navitalai Naivalurua · 13/11/2026

Munster captain Tadhg Beirne has been named captain of the Ireland side for their Nations Championship clash against the FIJI Water Flying Fijians this Sunday.

This will be the first time Beirne has led the side, while Bundee Aki returns from injury to partner Jamie Osborne in midfield.

Mack Hansen has been selected to start at full-back, with Robert Baloucoune and Tommy O’Brien named on the wings for Ireland.

Jamison Gibson-Park and Sam Prendergast combine in the halves.

In the pack, Andrew Porter, Rónan Kelleher and Tadhg Furlong are in the front row, with James Ryan and captain Beirne in the engine room.

Ryan Baird continues at blindside flanker, with Josh van der Flier at openside and Nick Timoney shifting to number eight.

On the bench, Tom Stewart, Tom O’Toole, Sam Illo, Darragh Murray and debutant McNabney are the forward replacements.

Craig Casey, Ciarán Frawley and Stuart McCloskey are the backline options.

Ireland will face Fiji at 8.10am on Sunday at Aviva Stadium in Dublin.

item.title: Four buses take Ra fans to Rakiraki for Farebrother Trophy clash
item.description: Four buses carrying Ra supporters left the Suva Flea Market this morning as fans turned out in numbers to back their team ahead of today's Inkk Farebrother Trophy clash against Nadroga. Speaking to fijivillage News, supporters expressed their pride and excitement over what the province has achieved in rugby this season.
item.content:encoded:
Four buses carrying Ra supporters left the Suva Flea Market this morning as fans turned out in numbers to back their team ahead of today's Inkk Farebrother Trophy clash against Nadroga.

Speaking to fijivillage News, supporters expressed their pride and excitement over what the province has achieved in rugby this season.

They say regardless of today's result, they will continue to support their province and cheer the team on to victory.

The fans say they will be cheering the players to defend their home turf, while acknowledging that Nadroga will not be an easy opponent given its reputation as a champion side.

Ra will face Nadroga in the Inkk Farebrother Trophy challenge at 3pm today at the Narauyaba Ground in Rakiraki.

item.content:encoded:
The Narauyaba Sports Ground playing surface remains suitable to host tomorrow's Inkk Farebrother Trophy Challenge despite concerns raised over its dry appearance, with preparations underway to ensure the safety and comfort of spectators.

The concerns follows the Fiji Rugby Union’s confirmation that Narauyaba Sports Ground in Ra will host the clash between current Farebrother Trophy holders Ra a nd Nadroga tomorrow.

During a visit to the venue, Minister for Youth and Sports Jese Saukuru says the ground’s current appearance was largely due to the effects of El Niño and prolonged dry weather.

Saukuru acknowledged the concerns raised by members of the public on social media and has assured that the playing surface remains in good condition for the much-anticipated encounter.

Saukuru confirms that portable toilets and temporary grandstands will be provided to improve facilities for spectators.

item.title: Ra ready for tough Farebrother Trophy challenge against Nadroga
item.description: Inkk Farebrother Trophy holders, Ra understands that taking on Nadroga will not be an easy feat this weekend, however, the players are looking forward to the challenge ahead. Speaking from Ra, Assistant coach Meli Wara says they have reviewed their game against Naitasiri last Saturday, identified their weaknesses, and have worked on improving them.
item.content:encoded:
Inkk Farebrother Trophy holders, Ra understands that taking on Nadroga will not be an easy feat this weekend, however, the players are looking forward to the challenge ahead.

Speaking from Ra, Assistant coach Meli Wara says they have reviewed their game against Naitasiri last Saturday, identified their weaknesses, and have worked on improving them.

Wara says the team has increased its intensity during training this week, knowing the strengths and capabilities of Nadroga. He acknowledges that facing a champion side like Nadroga will not be easy, with his players fully aware of the tough challenge that awaits them.

item.title: England beat Croatia 2-1 to secure Nations League quarter-final spot
item.description: England have secured a place in the UEFA Nations League quarter-finals after beating Croatia 2-1 with Harry Kane scoring the winning goal from the penalty spot. England went into half-time with a 1-0 lead after Morgan Rogers opened the scoring in the 24th minute, assisted by Jude Bellingham.
item.content:encoded:
England have secured a place in the UEFA Nations League quarter-finals after beating Croatia 2-1 with Harry Kane scoring the winning goal from the penalty spot.

England went into half-time with a 1-0 lead after Morgan Rogers opened the scoring in the 24th minute, assisted by Jude Bellingham.

Croatia fought back in the second half, with Petar Sučić scoring the equaliser in the 59th minute.

However, Kane restored England's lead from the penalty spot in the 64th minute to secure the 2-1 victory.

The match was also a special occasion for Kane, who became England's most-capped player.

Meanwhile, Spain defeated the Czech Republic 2-0 in their UEFA Nations League League A.
